games.reasoning: The market settled at Orlando -3.5 against nearly all the money, so the slate's -2.5 is a point of value on Orlando, but Orlando is short-handed (Black, Isaac out; Wagner's shoulder) under a new coach and Atlanta looks deep and sharp in preseason. Taking the -3.5 close as fair leaves only about a 1-point edge on Orlando, under the 2-point bar, so pass. A confirmed Wagner absence or the line reaching -4.5+ would have changed it.
